verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26837842 from Karton Nowak for Soony PO 4500318768 (dated 2026-10-13), DAP Hamburg, NET30. Confirms three lines: CMP-GAM-004 cover sleeve 75,000 pcs (item 00010) for 2026-11-04 and 74,000 pcs (item 00020) for 2026-11-12, both at 0.06 EUR; CMP-GAM-008 art book 8,000 pcs at 2.1 EUR for 2026-11-20. The note says the sleeves are printed to artwork rev. C, received from Soony Marketing 2026-08-07.
red_flags: CMP-GAM-004 is split into two lines (00010: 75,000 on 2026-11-04; 00020: 74,000 on 2026-11-12), and the lines are listed out of order (00020 before 00010). The original ordered quantities are not shown, so the split cannot be checked against the PO.
Supplier states CMP-GAM-004 is printed to artwork rev. C received 2026-08-07. The buyer should check that rev. C is the currently approved artwork revision.
The document does not state ordered quantities or a document date. The unit of measure is not given.
observations: Clean typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, or signatures.
Document date is not shown; only the referenced order date 2026-10-13 appears.
The Qty column has no unit of measure.
